messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English between two adult friends spending an ordinary evening together. Nothing important or dramatic happens. Let their familiarity show through small habits, casual conversation, comfortable silence, and little acts of consideration. Keep the scene specific and lived-in without explaining their relationship to the reader. Avoid clichés, melodrama, and artificial plot development. Output only the story prose.

Jordan came back from the kitchen carrying two glasses and set one down beside Alex without asking.

“That's mine?”

“You always steal mine.”

“I do not.”

“You absolutely do.”

Alex picked up the glass and took a sip. “Okay. This one is better.”

Jordan dropped onto the other end of the couch. “Exactly.”

The television played quietly in the background, neither of them paying much attention to it. Alex shifted her feet onto the coffee table.

“You're going to get comfortable and refuse to move, aren't you?” Jordan asked.

“Yes.”

“You've been here ten minutes.”

“I can work quickly.”

Jordan laughed and pulled the blanket from the back of the couch. She tossed it over Alex's legs.

“Thanks.”

“Don't make a big deal out of it.”

“I wasn't.”

“You were about to.”

Alex smiled and reached for the remote.

“What's this?”

“Whatever you want.”

“You're letting me pick?”

“For once.”

“That sounds suspicious.”

“Pick something.”

Alex scrolled through the menu for a while, stopping every few seconds to reject another option.

Jordan watched her. “You know we're going to spend twenty minutes choosing and then watch the first thing you looked at.”

“That has never happened.”

“It happens every time.”

Alex looked over at her. “You could stop me.”

“I could.”

“But you won't.”

“Nope.”

Alex smiled and kept scrolling.

A few minutes later, Jordan reached over and took the remote out of her hand.

“Hey.”

“We're watching this.”

“You just stole the remote.”

“See? Now you know how it feels.”

Alex laughed and settled back under the blanket. “Fine.”

Jordan nodded toward the screen. “Good choice.”

“I didn't choose it.”

“Details.””
